-# Google DeepMind Hackathon · 2026-10-16
+# A Thousand Stores · Google DeepMind Hackathon (2026-10-16)
 
-Public repository for a project built in Antigravity during the hackathon.
+> **Verified reference MVP (2026-10-16).** The 6 repository tests and 10 independent local checks passed. Actual Chrome checks passed at desktop 1440px and mobile 390px, including stale inputs, reversed response order, fresh human decisions and JSON evidence export. Gemini checks used mocks; live provider calls, container builds and Cloud Run deployment remain unverified.
+>
+> This branch contains a standalone reference implementation. Integration with the TypeScript lane structure and frozen shared contract added to `main` at `a869ef8` remains pending. See [integration notes](docs/INTEGRATION_NOTES.md) for the exact differences; these local checks do not certify the main project's AT-01–AT-16 gates.
 
-This initial commit contains the prepared public Seoul commercial-area data
-and source documentation only. Application code, deployment and model
-execution have not been completed by this repository setup.
+## Overview
 
-## Data
+**A Thousand Stores** helps a prospective Seoul cafe owner decide **what to measure in the field before signing a commercial lease**. It is a scenario analysis and pre-lease measurement workbench, not an individual store survival predictor or financial advisor.
 
-- Coverage: 2021Q1-2026Q2, 22 quarters.
-- Ten unchanged annual ZIPs for 2021-2025, plus two 2026-only UTF-8 CSVs.
-- [Data notes](data/seoul/README.md)
-- [File sizes and SHA-256 hashes](data/seoul/manifest.json)
-- [Attribution and reuse terms](LICENSE_NOTICE.txt)
+### Core Path (P0)
+1. **Attributed Public Seoul Context (`data/seoul/context_2026_sample.json`)**:
+   - Uses verified 2026Q2 (`기준_년분기_코드 = 20262`, `CS100010` 커피-음료) rows from `OA-15577` (stores) and `OA-15572` (estimated sales).
+   - Preserves raw area names verbatim (including `종로?청계 관광특구` for code `3001494`).
+   - Preserves raw sales (`당월_매출_금액`) and transactions (`당월_매출_건수`) with explicit notice that period aggregation semantics in the quarter-keyed table are unconfirmed (never divided by 3 or by store count).
+   - Missing sales rows in `OA-15572` (e.g., `3110001` 이북5도청사, `3110005` 세검정, `3110007` 사직공원) remain `null` (never coerced to `0`) and cannot produce a data-derived rank or cashflow.
+2. **Deterministic 36-Month Cashflow & Reserve Gate (`src/domain/cashflowEngine.js`)**:
+   - `Initial available cash (C0) = budget - locked deposit - opening expenditure` (deposit is never a monthly expense).
+   - **10% Reserve Gate**: `C0 >= 10%` of original budget (`C0 * 10 >= budget`).
+   - **Conserved KRW Rounding Convention**:
+     - `monthlySales = Math.round(avgTicket * transactionsPerDay * tradingDaysPerMonth)`
+     - `monthlyVariableCost = Math.round(monthlySales * variableCostRatio)`
+     - `monthlyContribution = monthlySales - monthlyVariableCost`
+     - `monthlyOperatingCashChange = monthlyContribution - Math.round(monthlyFixedCost)`
+   - Reports **Zero-Cash Boundary Month** (`endingCash <= 0`) and **First Negative-Cash Month** (`endingCash < 0`) separately.
+3. **Seeded 1,000 Assumed Scenario Batch**:
+   - Deterministic PRNG (`xmur3` + `Mulberry32`) over bounded perturbations; preserves exact base values under zero spread and reports `distinctScenarioCount`.
+   - Relative variation of zero transactions stays zero. Counts describe chosen assumptions, not measured probabilities of store survival. The monthly model uses constant assumptions and has not been calibrated to individual stores.
+4. **Optional Bounded Server-Side Gemini Proposal (`src/services/geminiProposalService.js`)**:
+   - Calls `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions` using `GEMINI_API_KEY` from server environment only and configurable `GEMINI_MODEL` (default `gemini-3.8-flash`).
+   - Enforces per-instance in-flight limit (`1`), lifetime call quota (`10`), request timeout, output token budget, sanitized errors, and deterministic verifier check. Returns explicit `unconfigured` status (`HTTP 503`) when `GEMINI_API_KEY` is absent. The quota resets on restart and is not a project-wide billing cap.
 
-Copyright holder: Seoul Metropolitan Government. Provider: Seoul Credit
-Guarantee Foundation. Data reuse: Korea Open Government License Type 1
-(attribution). Do not interpret estimated sales as audited revenues, fill
-missing sales with zero, or equate aggregate closure rates with individual
-store survival probabilities.
+## Local Setup & Commands (Node 20+, Zero Dependencies)
 
-## Development handoff
+```bash
+# Run acceptance & HTTP smoke tests (Node 20+ built-in test runner)
+npm test
 
-Use Antigravity to open this repository. Keep one writer per file and
-verify changes on the exact commit being shared. Do not commit API keys,
-service-account credentials, private company material or local logs.
+# Start the server locally on http://localhost:8080
+npm start
 
-Actual application setup and deployment instructions will be added after
-they have been implemented and tested in Antigravity.
+# Optional: enable live Gemini bounded proposal endpoint (server-only env var)
+GEMINI_API_KEY="your_api_key_here" GEMINI_MODEL="gemini-3.8-flash" npm start
+```
+
+## Container and Cloud Run
+
+The production image uses Node 22. The container recipe is supplied; a container build and Cloud deployment still require separate verification. The application serves a 12-area cafe sample; the full 22-quarter public archive stays in GitHub and is excluded from deployment uploads.
+
+```bash
+# Build container locally (excludes 111MB raw data/CSVs, logs, and credentials via .dockerignore)
+docker build -t a-thousand-stores:local .
+docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 a-thousand-stores:local
+```
+
+After authenticating to the intended Google Cloud project, deploy from this repository with an explicit target. This command creates a public service; the Gemini endpoint stays unavailable until a server-side key is configured.
+
+```bash
+GDH_PROJECT_ID="your-authorized-project-id"
+GDH_REGION="asia-northeast3"
+gcloud run deploy a-thousand-stores \
+  --source . \
+  --project "$GDH_PROJECT_ID" \
+  --region "$GDH_REGION" \
+  --allow-unauthenticated \
+  --min-instances 0 --max-instances 1 \
+  --cpu 1 --memory 256Mi --concurrency 8 --timeout 30s
+```
+
+Configure `GEMINI_API_KEY` on the server, preferably through Secret Manager; never put it in client code, Git or a shared prompt. Verify `/api/health`, then make one deliberate live proposal request. A configured-key flag or a mocked test is not evidence that the provider call succeeded. The [official Cloud Run guide](https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/quickstarts/build-and-deploy/deploy-nodejs-service) covers required project access and deployment setup.
+

+

+- **Copyright Holder**: Seoul Metropolitan Government (서울특별시)
+- **Provider**: Seoul Credit Guarantee Foundation (서울신용보증재단)
+- **License**: Korea Open Government License Type 1 (attribution required; see [LICENSE_NOTICE.txt](LICENSE_NOTICE.txt) and [data/seoul/README.md](data/seoul/README.md))

+# A Thousand Stores: hackathon MVP contract
+
+Target: help a prospective cafe owner decide what to measure before signing a lease. Build during the hackathon in Antigravity. This is scenario analysis, not individual survival prediction or financial advice.
+
+## P0
+
+- One complete path: explicit input assumptions -> deterministic 36-month cashflow -> 1,000 seeded assumption scenarios -> a transaction-volume break-even boundary -> next measurement -> human decision (hold / measure / proceed).
+- Use attributed public Seoul data already in this repository as observed context. Never replace missing sales with zero or infer an individual store's transactions from aggregate sales. Distinguish observed data, user assumptions, AI suggestions, and unverified results.
+- Initial available cash = budget - locked deposit - opening expenditure. Deposit is not a recurring expense. Monthly sales = average ticket x transactions/day x trading days/month. Monthly operating cash change = sales x (1 - variable-cost ratio) - fixed cash outflows. Avoid calling it net profit: taxes, debt, depreciation and working capital are not modeled.
+- Reserve gate: initial available cash >= 10% of original budget. Report zero-cash boundary and first negative-cash month separately. After negative cash, projection is arithmetic only; continued operation or financing is not established.
+- Batch counts describe assumed scenarios, not probability estimates. A deterministic preset must be labeled as such, and must not be presented as a Gemini run. LLM proposes bounded assumptions; deterministic code verifies and computes. One bounded Gemini call per requested proposal, with request timeout and explicit error/unconfigured states.
+- UI: a useful polished responsive dashboard, input form, attributed context, 36-month curve, scenario distribution, boundary/next measurement, human decision and downloadable evidence with run ID, exact inputs, seed, model/usage when actually available, source files and verifier results. No fake latency, success rate, token counts or calibration claim.
+- Google AI: server-side Gemini integration using current official API; configurable model, API key from server environment only. Never put credentials in client files, logs, git, API responses or chat. An unavailable model/key must remain unavailable, not silently fake AI output.
+- Google Cloud: Cloud Run compatible server/Dockerfile and accurate deploy instructions. Do not deploy, enable billing, create accounts, read credentials, or change cloud project during initial implementation. Active cloud login is currently not available to this execution environment.
+- Exclude voice, 3D, external messaging, speculative calibration, automated lease decisions and uncontrolled parallel LLM calls.
+
+## Independent synthetic acceptance cases
+
+These are fixed arithmetic or missingness checks, not real-world performance data.
+
+1. B=120,000,000; D=30,000,000; K=42,000,000; ticket=5,000; transactions/day=100; days/month=24; variable ratio=.35; monthly fixed=6,000,000. C0=48,000,000; monthly sales=12,000,000; operating cash change=+1,800,000; month36 cash=112,800,000. First integer daily volume with positive cash change is 77.
+2. Same inputs, explicit transactions/day=0: sales=0; change=-6,000,000; month8 cash=0; first negative month=9. Distinguish this explicit zero from missing input.
+3. B=120,000,000; D=108,000,000; K=0: reserve 12,000,000 passes exact 10%. D=109,000,000: reserve 11,000,000 fails. Deposit is never monthly expense.
+4. Store row exists but no corresponding sales row: observed sales stays missing and cannot produce a data-derived cashflow or rank. An explicit separate user transaction assumption can enable a user-assumption simulation. Missing or blank transaction input must not coerce to zero.
+
+## Verification budget and completion
+
+Initial budget: one Antigravity implementation session (up to 15 minutes), two focused repair passes if an actual defect is found, one code/security review, one independent arithmetic suite, one HTTP smoke suite and browser check if a browser is available. Model calls: at most one deliberate live Gemini smoke call after credentials are configured; mocked tests must be labeled. Costs remain unmeasured unless reported by the provider. Stop repeating a failed path without new evidence.
+
+Completion requires actual commands and outputs, not self-assessed quality. Local tests, GitHub readback, live Gemini execution and deployed URL are separate statuses. Do not claim unexecuted stages complete.

+# Verified reference MVP: integration handoff
+
+Observed upstream: `a869ef85da9bccfc73f9ce3c0eb853c9eab26587` on 2026-10-16. Its `AGENTS.md`, `docs/SPEC.md`, `shared/types.ts` and root `package.json` introduce a TypeScript A1/A2/A3 lane structure and frozen shared contract. This branch began from the earlier public-data commit `6b74c8c` and is a standalone executable reference. It must be reviewed before integration: its root package and Docker configuration differ from upstream.
+
+## What has execution evidence
+
+- Antigravity authored the application code. Independent local verification used separate fixed arithmetic inputs, actual public CSV values, HTTP requests and an isolated Chrome profile.
+- `npm test`: 6/6 passed, including the corrected official REST-shaped Gemini mock.
+- Independent verifier: 10/10 passed for exact cash boundaries, reserve accounting, KRW rounding, zero and missing values, zero-spread identity, seed reproducibility, invalid types, mocked provider completion/quotas and HTTP provenance.
+- Actual Chrome: baseline amounts, zero-volume months 8/9, blank-input rejection, missing source sales, 390px width without overflow, in-flight edits, reversed response order, per-run human decision reset and exported JSON snapshot passed. No browser exceptions were observed in that test.
+- Gemini live calls, container build, Cloud Run, calibration, benchmark, random/grid comparison and main acceptance gates are unverified. No main AT pass count is asserted.
+
+## Differences that need an adapter or further implementation
+
+| Area | This reference | Upstream contract / remaining work |
+|---|---|---|
+| Layout / API | Dependency-free JS in `src/`, static `public/`, `/api/simulate` | TS lanes `engine/`, `loop/`, `web/`; `/run`, `/runs/:id`, `/patches`; preserve existing root config |
+| Cashflow | Constant explicit monthly transaction/cost assumptions; deposit remains locked through month 36 | Full store/scenario engine with labour, rent, capacity and shocks; upstream requires deposit returned in final month. Reconcile this policy explicitly before comparing expected month-36 values |
+| Constraints | Reports a reserve failure and cash shortfall separately | Invalid designs must be rejected separately from operating deaths; add full area/seat/budget and patch constraints |
+| Scenarios / AI | 1,000 seeded numeric assumption variations; optional one-call bounded proposal endpoint | Argon structural design patches, forbidden-path validator, model usage per call and baseline comparison remain to implement |
+| Cliff / measurement | Cash-positive daily transaction boundary; two suggested measurement checks | One leading-design rank flip and its one linked next measurement; do not relabel this arithmetic boundary as an AT-07 cliff |
+| Public data | 12 verified 2026Q2 cafe-area context records with source rows/hashes; 3 missing-sales records stay null | Full 22-quarter tagged loaders and calibration/holdout gates. Aggregate rates do not establish individual-store survival or cashflow accuracy |
+| Run evidence | Fresh request/input snapshot, decision and downloadable JSON; unlinked Gemini usage omitted | Persistent append-only run records, input SHA-256, engine git SHA, terminal state/replay/gate log and canonical `RunResult` remain to connect |
+| Export / deploy | JSON download, Node 22 Docker recipe, upload exclusions | Docs/Sheets or CSV path and actual authorized Cloud deployment remain unverified |
+
+## Safe reuse
+
+Lane owners can reuse the arithmetic edge cases, conserved KRW rounding policy, missing-sales handling, request sequence/snapshot guard, explicit per-run decisions, official REST parser and credential exclusions. Port these to the existing interfaces and rerun the verifier-owned acceptance suite. Keep the current `shared/`, `tests/`, oracle values and production root scripts unchanged while reviewing this reference.
+
+Model-generated assumptions are checked for bounds and arithmetic only. That check is not evidence that their business assumptions are correct. The UI labels the model as unavailable when no key is configured; seeded simulations are never presented as AI-generated designs or real-world survival probabilities.
